walkthrough_add_bar.message: Tap any empty space twice and a new bar will pop up.

walkthrough_color.message: Nice work! Now try tapping a piece to color it in.

walkthrough_split.message: Great. Now tap a piece two times quickly and watch it split in half.

walkthrough_drag.message: You can also move pieces around. Drag any piece across the screen.

walkthrough_remove.message: Last one — hold a piece for a moment to take it away. After this we'll start exploring fractions!
